entries.name: earth.nullschool.net
entries.description: Animated global wind, ocean currents and temperature on a spinnable globe.

entries.name: Windy
entries.description: Multiple weather models side by side with a cleaner interface.

entries.name: GlobalQuake
entries.description: Open seismic network aggregating public stations for near-instant quake detection.

entries.name: EarthquakeTrack
entries.description: Earthquake feed and per-location history, largely repackaged USGS data.

entries.name: BGS Geomagnetism
entries.description: British Geological Survey magnetometer readings and field disturbance.

entries.name: NOAA SWPC
entries.description: Solar flares, Kp index and geomagnetic storm warnings.

entries.name: Tide-Forecast
entries.description: Tidal predictions for coastal locations worldwide.

entries.name: NASA Ocean Color
entries.description: Satellite chlorophyll and sea surface temperature data.

entries.name: NASA Worldview
entries.description: Browser for near-real-time satellite imagery layers.

entries.name: Copernicus
entries.description: EU earth observation programme; granular European coverage.

entries.name: CO2.earth
entries.description: Current atmospheric CO2 concentration from Mauna Loa.

entries.name: Climate TRACE
entries.description: Greenhouse emissions attributed to individual facilities via satellite inference.

entries.name: Global Forest Watch
entries.description: Satellite-derived deforestation alerts and forest cover change.

entries.name: IQAir Earth
entries.description: Real-time PM2.5 air quality from monitors worldwide.

entries.name: NETC
entries.description: Crowdsourced radiation readings; indicative rather than authoritative.

entries.name: Global Fishing Watch
entries.description: Commercial fishing vessel activity from AIS; used for illegal-fishing detection.

entries.name: Flightradar24
entries.description: Consumer flight tracker built on ADS-B transponder data.

entries.name: OpenSky Network
entries.description: Research-oriented ADS-B network with a genuinely open API.

entries.name: ADS-B Exchange
entries.description: Unfiltered ADS-B; retains military and blocked aircraft.

entries.name: MarineTraffic
entries.description: AIS ship tracking; commercial product with a limited free view.

entries.name: Ship & Bunker
entries.description: Marine fuel prices by port; a clean read on trade cost pressure.

entries.name: ACLED
entries.description: Academic-grade coded conflict and protest event data.

entries.name: Liveuamap
entries.description: Geolocated conflict reporting; faster than ACLED, less rigorous.

entries.name: Observe.earth
entries.description: Aggregator combining conflict, outbreak and fuel price layers.

entries.name: Global Incident Map
entries.description: Disease outbreak incidents mapped from news reports.

entries.name: The World Now
entries.description: Globe visualising ongoing conflicts and disasters.

entries.name: UNHCR Data
entries.description: Authoritative displacement and migration flow data.

entries.name: ENTSO-E Transparency
entries.description: Hourly EU generation, load and cross-border flows with a real API.

entries.name: Ember
entries.description: European electricity generation by fuel source; relevant to CBAM.

entries.name: FRED
entries.description: St. Louis Fed economic time series; excellent free API with vintage data.

entries.name: Trading Economics
entries.description: Global indicators calendar; useful for release timing.

entries.name: mempool.space
entries.description: Bitcoin mempool explorer: unconfirmed transactions, fee rates, block space.

entries.name: Kaspersky Cybermap
entries.description: Stylised globe of attacks hitting Kaspersky sensors; marketing more than intelligence.

entries.name: Internet Live Stats
entries.description: Extrapolated internet usage counters, not measured throughput.

entries.name: Wikimedia Statistics
entries.description: Wikipedia edit and pageview data; a decent attention proxy.

entries.name: ISS Tracker
entries.description: International Space Station orbital position in real time.

entries.name: Dead Drops
entries.description: Map of USB sticks cemented into public walls; a 2010 art project, mostly defunct.
